patches.reason: Two author errors. Permission writes else (choice == 1) without its if, so the "I don't require anything" choice stopped the legacy script with an error instead of going back to Main: write else if (choice == 1). The easy and medium settings save the yellow-bead count as currentBlackBeads, right after startingYellowBeads, so changing the setting mid-chastity overwrote the black count and left yellow unchanged: save currentYellowBeads, as the hard setting does.
